title: Surreal Collage Dreamscape
description: A surreal digital collage divided into horizontal sections. The top features a profile of a braided woman facing a large composite face with a glowing sunset eye, a gnarled dead tree under twin moons, and a long-necked alien creature. The bottom is dominated by a large metallic green insect with prominent compound eyes standing on a vibrant green liquid surface with blue and yellow paint splashes and drips.
prompt: Surreal digital collage with a profile of a dark-skinned woman with braided hair on the left, a giant fragmented face containing a glowing sunset eye, a dead gnarled tree against a starry night sky with two moons, a tall alien creature with a single large eye, and a large metallic green insect with big compound eyes standing in vibrant green liquid with blue and yellow paint splashes and drips flowing down, dreamlike symbolic composition
